---
title: "DESeq2 sex check"
author: "Daniel Gregory"
format: html
editor: visual
---

Testing if adding sex as a covariate changes up/down-regulated results and if gene-by-gene there are significant interaction effects due to sex.

Inputs are saved at the end of `deseq2-analysis.qmd`.

```{r}
library(DESeq2)

inp <- readRDS("data/processed/deseq2_output_Brain_Cortex_vs_Whole_Blood.rds")
dds <- readRDS("data/processed/deseq2_dds_Brain_Cortex_vs_Whole_Blood.rds")
res <- inp$res
target <- inp$settings$target
ref <- inp$settings$ref
alpha <- inp$settings$alpha
lfc_cutoff <- inp$settings$lfc_cutoff
```

```{r}
table(dds$SEX, dds$group) # 1 = male, 2 = female

dds_sex <- dds
dds_sex$SEX <- factor(ifelse(dds_sex$SEX == 1, "Male", "Female"), levels = c("Male", "Female"))

# 1. Sex as a covariate
design(dds_sex) <- ~ SEX + group
res_cov <- results(DESeq(dds_sex, quiet = TRUE), contrast = c("group", target, ref))
hits <- res$padj < alpha & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > lfc_cutoff
hits_cov <- res_cov$padj < alpha & abs(res_cov$log2FoldChange) > lfc_cutoff
c(without_sex = sum(hits, na.rm = TRUE), with_sex = sum(hits_cov, na.rm = TRUE), in_both = sum(hits & hits_cov, na.rm = TRUE))
```

Genes that pass in only one of the two models. Small padj or LFC changes near the cutoffs are expected.

```{r}
switched <- which(xor(hits %in% TRUE, hits_cov %in% TRUE))
switched_tab <- data.frame(symbol = res$symbol[switched],
  passes_in = ifelse(hits[switched] %in% TRUE, "without sex", "with sex"),
  lfc = round(res$log2FoldChange[switched], 2), lfc_with_sex = round(res_cov$log2FoldChange[switched], 2),
  padj = signif(res$padj[switched], 2), padj_with_sex = signif(res_cov$padj[switched], 2))
switched_tab
```

# Sex x tissue interaction

Asks, gene by gene, if the cortex vs. blood difference is different in women and men. Read from the saved interaction results (model: \~ sex + age + group + sex:group + age:group), so nothing is refit here. sex_lfc \> 0 = the cortex vs. blood log2 FC is larger in women.

Chromosomes come from the NCBI annotation (matched by Ensembl ID). Genes it doesn't cover (mostly non-coding) are "Unknown".

```{r}
int <- read.csv("results/deseq2/deseq2_Brain_Cortex_vs_Whole_Blood_interaction.csv")
annot <- read.delim("data/raw/Human.GRCh38.p13.annot.tsv.gz", quote = "")
annot <- annot[annot$EnsemblGeneID != "" & !duplicated(annot$EnsemblGeneID), ]
chr <- annot$ChrAcc[match(sub("\\..*", "", int$gene_id), annot$EnsemblGeneID)]
int$chrom <- ifelse(is.na(chr), "Unknown", ifelse(grepl("NC_000023|NC_000024", chr), "X/Y", "Other"))

int_hits <- int[int$sex_padj < alpha & !is.na(int$sex_padj), ]
int_hits <- int_hits[order(int_hits$sex_padj), ]
```

Slide summary: how many genes have a sex-dependent tissue difference, and how many of those are over 2-fold (\|sex_lfc\| \> 1).

```{r}
slide_tab <- data.frame(chromosome = c("X/Y", "Other", "Unknown", "Total"),
  genes = c(sum(int_hits$chrom == "X/Y"), sum(int_hits$chrom == "Other"), sum(int_hits$chrom == "Unknown"), nrow(int_hits)),
  over_2_fold = c(sum(abs(int_hits$sex_lfc[int_hits$chrom == "X/Y"]) > 1), sum(abs(int_hits$sex_lfc[int_hits$chrom == "Other"]) > 1),
    sum(abs(int_hits$sex_lfc[int_hits$chrom == "Unknown"]) > 1), sum(abs(int_hits$sex_lfc) > 1)))
slide_tab
c(genes_tested = sum(!is.na(int$sex_padj)), percent_hit = round(100 * nrow(int_hits) / sum(!is.na(int$sex_padj)), 1))

# top non-sex-chromosome genes, by size of the sex difference
top_other <- int_hits[int_hits$chrom == "Other" & int_hits$baseMean >= 100, ]
head(top_other[order(-abs(top_other$sex_lfc)), c("symbol", "tissue_lfc", "sex_lfc", "sex_padj", "baseMean")], 10)

write.csv(int_hits, "results/deseq2/sex_interaction_hits.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
